name: Implement order lifecycle state machine with history tracking
description: Implement OrderStateMachine with states PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, state guards, and transition history in src/order-machine.ts.

inputs.task_prompt: Implement the OrderStateMachine class in src/order-machine.ts. Valid states: PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED. Initial state is PENDING. Transitions: 1) startProcessing(): PENDING -> PROCESSING, 2) complete(): PROCESSING -> COMPLETED, 3) cancel(reason: string): PENDING or PROCESSING -> CANCELLED. Any invalid transition must throw InvalidStateTransitionError. Expose getState(), getHistory() (array of { from, to, timestamp, reason? }), and isTerminal(). All tests in test/order-machine.test.ts must pass.

acceptance_criteria: startProcessing transitions from PENDING to PROCESSING
complete transitions from PROCESSING to COMPLETED
cancel transitions from PENDING or PROCESSING to CANCELLED
getHistory tracks timestamp and transition metadata
isTerminal returns true for COMPLETED and CANCELLED
